localHintHost: Local metrics still work. Open links and directed Wake-on-LAN need a LAN IP.

add.title: Add Spark/GPU Host
add.thisHost: This host (local collectors, no SSH for metrics)
add.windowsHint: Needs the Windows OpenSSH Server and the NVIDIA driver (nvidia-smi). Metrics come from PowerShell over SSH; Hermes and Tailnet checks are not available for Windows.
add.lanIpOptionalHost: LAN IP (optional, browser links and Wake-on-LAN)
add.sshPortHint: Default port 22. Change it when sshd listens elsewhere.
add.keyHint: SSH runs on the sparkDash host (not your browser). In Docker, mount a private key at /root/.ssh/id_ed25519 (see docker-compose.yml) or set SSH_IDENTITY_FILE. IPs are from that host's network. Mark this machine as “This host” so it skips SSH.
add.passwordHint: Stored encrypted on the server (not in sparks.json, not returned by the API). Survives Docker restarts.
add.testHint: Checks SSH, hardware and LLM before you add it. Optional.
add.nameHint: Shown in the sidebar and on the Overview.
add.workerNoPorts: Workers have no local LLM API, so no ports are probed.
add.comfyHint: Job queue and live progress. Default port 8188.
add.hermesHint: Checks for new releases every 10 min and adds an Update Hermes button.

edit.passwordSavedEncrypted: Password saved encrypted (works even while host is offline).
edit.enterPasswordFirst: Enter the SSH password first — it will be saved even if the host is down.
edit.passwordRequiredSave: Password required for password-auth Sparks (saved encrypted, host can be offline).
edit.confirmRemoveSpark: Remove Spark "{{name}}"? This cannot be undone.
edit.confirmRemoveHost: Remove GPU Host "{{name}}"? This cannot be undone.
edit.name: Name
edit.lanIpOptionalHost: LAN IP (optional — browser links and Wake-on-LAN)
edit.macHintDetected: Using enP7s7 automatically ({{mac}}). Leave blank to keep auto, or enter a different MAC.
edit.macHint: Leave blank to use enP7s7 once the host has been online and detected.
edit.thisHost: This host (local collectors — no SSH for metrics)
edit.roleTip: Head always monitors the local LLM. Standalone can opt in/out. Workers have no local API — the LLM card is hidden and ports are not probed.
edit.roleTipAria: Head always monitors the local LLM. Standalone can opt in or out. Workers hide the LLM card and do not probe ports.
edit.llmMonitoringTip: When enabled, probe the local LLM API and show the LLM card on this Spark.
edit.llmMonitoringAria: Enable probing the local LLM API and showing the LLM card.
edit.comfyTip: When enabled, probe ComfyUI on this host and show a ComfyUI card. Default port is 8188 — change the port value on the right if needed.
edit.comfyAria: Enable probing ComfyUI and showing the ComfyUI card.
edit.hermesTip: Hermes Agent CLI is installed on this machine (nousresearch/hermes-agent). When enabled, sparkDash checks for updates (hermes update --check) and can run “hermes update” for you via SSH with one click.
edit.hermesAria: Hermes Agent CLI is installed on this machine; enable update monitoring and one-click updates.
edit.hermesHintBefore: Checks for updates in the background (10 min) and adds an "Update Hermes" button that runs
edit.tailnetTip: When enabled, run `tailscale status --json` on this host and show a Tailnet card. Catches a unit that is healthy on the LAN but has fallen off its tailnet. Requires the tailscale CLI. Default off.
edit.tailnetAria: Enable reporting this unit's tailnet presence.
edit.workerLabelHint: Shown on the overview card. Leave blank to show “distributed”.
edit.headSparkHint: Optional. Which Spark serves as the cluster head for this worker.
edit.sshPortHint: Default 22. Use this when sshd listens elsewhere.
edit.keyHint: SSH runs on the sparkDash host. Docker: mount a key at /root/.ssh/id_ed25519 (or SSH_IDENTITY_FILE). IPs are from that host, not your laptop.
edit.sshPasswordKeep: SSH Password (leave blank to keep stored secret)
edit.sshPasswordRequired: SSH Password (required — saved even if host is offline)
edit.passwordStored: Password is stored encrypted on this server. Offline Sparks still keep it and reconnect automatically when back up.
edit.passwordEnterOnce: Enter once and Save (or Test). Stored encrypted — host does not need to be online.
